core_limit.name: Core memories per request
core_limit.hint: Maximum number of visible core memories loaded each turn (1–20). Does not limit stored memories.

zh.name: 每轮核心记忆数
zh.hint: 每轮加载的可见核心记忆上限（1–20），不限制存储条数。

recall_limit.name: Retrieved memories per request
recall_limit.hint: Maximum candidates for automatic recall (1–20). Vector retrieval and reranking are optional; keyword search alone needs no model calls.

zh.name: 每轮检索记忆数
zh.hint: 自动召回的候选上限（1–20）。向量检索和重排序均可选，仅关键词检索无需模型调用。

recall_query_char_limit.name: Recall query character limit
recall_query_char_limit.hint: Maximum characters in the combined recall query from the latest three messages. Default 0 means unlimited. A positive integer keeps only the first N characters. Applies equally to conversations and recall preview; the selected Embedding or Rerank service may have its own input limits.

zh.name: 召回查询字符上限
zh.hint: 最近三条消息合并后的召回查询字符上限，默认 0 表示不限制。设置正整数后仅保留前 N 个字符，对真实对话和模拟召回同时生效；所选 Embedding 或 Rerank 服务可能另有输入限制。

prompt_char_budget.name: Memory context character budget
prompt_char_budget.hint: Character budget for memory records injected per request (1500–20000), split between core and retrieved records.

zh.name: 记忆上下文字符预算
zh.hint: 每轮注入记忆记录的字符预算（1500–20000），由核心记忆和检索记忆分配。

search_char_budget.name: Memory search response character budget
search_char_budget.hint: Character budget per search response (5000–30000). Use pagination or a memory ID for more records.

zh.name: 记忆检索返回字符预算
zh.hint: 每次检索返回记录的字符预算（5000–30000），可通过分页或记忆 ID 获取更多内容。

vector_enabled.name: Vector retrieval
vector_enabled.hint: Optional remote Embedding API for hybrid recall. Disabled by default. Enabling sends memory text to the selected provider and builds a background index; install dependencies from the memory dashboard if needed.

zh.name: 向量检索
zh.hint: 默认关闭。开启后通过远程 Embedding API 增强召回，会将记忆正文发送给所选服务商，并在后台构建索引；缺少依赖时请在记忆管理页安装。

embedding_model.hint: Select an existing remote Embedding model. Leave empty to use the default Embedding model. Reuse requires the same underlying model, even if names differ between channels. Only vector dimensions are checked. Changing models requires a manual WebUI rebuild, which may incur significant API costs. Dimension mismatches never trigger automatic rebuilds.
embedding_model.name: Memory embedding model

zh.name: 记忆 Embedding 模型
zh.hint: 选择已有的远程 Embedding 模型，留空使用默认 Embedding 模型。请使用相同底层模型，渠道名称可不同；系统只检查向量维度。换模型需到 WebUI 手动重建，可能产生较多 API 费用；维度不一致时不会自动重建。

embedding_timeout.name: Embedding timeout
embedding_timeout.hint: Maximum seconds per Embedding request (1–30), including concurrency wait. Failures fall back to keyword retrieval.

zh.name: Embedding 请求超时
zh.hint: 每次请求的最长等待秒数（1–30），包含并发排队时间。失败时回退到关键词检索。

vector_min_similarity.name: Minimum vector similarity
vector_min_similarity.hint: Minimum cosine similarity for semantic candidates (0–1). Tune using recall preview for the selected model.

zh.name: 最低向量相似度
zh.hint: 语义候选的最低余弦相似度（0–1），可根据所选模型在模拟召回中调整。

zh.name: Rerank 重排序
zh.hint: 默认关闭，可独立于向量检索使用。将检索词和候选记忆正文发送给所选服务商，会增加延迟和 API 费用；失败时保留原始排序。

rerank_enabled.hint: Optional remote reranking of retrieved candidates. Disabled by default and independent of vector retrieval. Sends the query and candidate memory text to the selected provider, adding latency and API costs. Failures retain the original order.
rerank_enabled.name: Rerank

rerank_model.name: Memory rerank model
rerank_model.hint: Select an existing rerank model. Leave empty to use the default rerank model. No index rebuild is needed when changing this model.

zh.name: 记忆 Rerank 模型
zh.hint: 选择已有的重排序模型，留空使用本体默认重排序模型。更换此模型无需重建索引。

zh.name: Rerank 候选数
zh.hint: 选取最终结果前，对前 2–100 条候选重排序（默认 30）。每次最多发送 60000 字符的候选正文，每条最多 4000 字符；窗口外的候选保留原始顺序。

rerank_candidates.hint: Rerank the first 2–100 retrieved candidates before selecting the final results (default 30). Each request sends at most 60,000 document characters, with at most 4,000 per memory. Candidates beyond this window retain their original order.
rerank_candidates.name: Rerank candidate count

zh.name: Rerank 请求超时
zh.hint: 每次请求的最长等待秒数（1–30），包含并发排队时间。失败时保留原始排序，并暂停重试 30 秒。

rerank_timeout.hint: Maximum seconds per rerank request (1–30), including concurrency wait. Failures retain the original order and pause retries for 30 seconds.
rerank_timeout.name: Rerank timeout
